methodologyNotes: Roster covers thirteen current or recently-current snowshoes spanning ultralight mountaineering (MSR Lightning Ascent, Atlas Helium-BC, TSL Symbioz Hyperflex Elite), all-mountain/backcountry (MSR Revo Explore, Tubbs Flex VRT, Atlas Montane, Yukon Charlie's Pro), rolling-terrain day-hiking (MSR Evo Trail, Tubbs Wilderness, Chinook Trekker, Retrospec Drifter), and beginner/frameless designs (Crescent Moon EVA Foam), verified 2026-08-11 directly against manufacturer product pages (cascadedesigns.com/MSR, tubbssnowshoes.com, atlassnowshoe.com, tsloutdoor.com, crescentmoongear.com) and, where a manufacturer page could not be reached live, corroborating retailer pages (Hilton's Tent City, REI, Retrospec.com, Yukon Charlie's own store); frame_length_in and weight_per_pair_lb are left null wherever a brand publishes only weight-class (TSL's S/M/L sizing) or omits a figure entirely (Tubbs, Atlas, Louis Garneau) rather than estimating from a similarly-branded sibling model. One correction from the seed list: Louis Garneau's own current site (garneau.com) only sells the successor "Blizzard III"; the requested "Blizzard II" is a discontinued-but-real prior generation, so its entry is sourced from REI's still-live product listing (corroborated by CampSaver, OpticsPlanet, Backcountry, and Trailspace listings under the identical name) with its price reconstructed as $159.96 paid + $39.99 discount = $199.95 per a first-hand purchase review (paddleandtrails.com), flagged in priceNote rather than presented as a confirmed manufacturer MSRP. accessedAt 2026-08-11 throughout.
